label: For "Hospital Quality Measure Performance Forecasting": Forecast quality measure outcomes and identify the facilities and units likely to miss internal or external performance targets early enough for improvement work to change the result. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Backtesting on final data without reporting lag.
